Project "OpenNoteLM (Inspired by Google NotebookLM)" (AI Systems): AI document intelligence workspace inspired by Google NotebookLM. Engineered a full Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using Gemini 2.5 Flash and Vertex AI embeddings to enable low-latency streaming chat over user-uploaded PDFs. Built real-time reactive architecture with Convex, integrated native vector search over 768-D embeddings, and implemented strict grounding mechanisms to eliminate hallucinations. Designed modular knowledge transformation tools (Quiz, Flashcards, Mind Maps) and optimized end-to-end inference latency (~120–250ms TTFT) with retrieval under ~50ms. Serverless architecture ensures cost-efficient scaling with zero idle infrastructure overhead. Stack: Gemini 2.5 Flash, Vertex AI, Convex, Vector Search, Next.js, TypeScript, React, Material UI, text-embedding-004, Python, Serverless Architecture. GitHub: https://github.com/sri/opennotelm. Demo: none.

section: Project: Portfolio Website with Interactive AI Chat Bot

Project "MAiGen" (Bioinformatics): End-to-end AI-driven clinical decision support system for interpreting metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) reports. The pipeline integrates microbial signal processing, weighted pathogen ranking, contaminant filtering, host immune response analysis, PubMed-backed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and safety-constrained LLM reasoning to generate structured, literature-grounded infectious disease reports with hallucination controls. Stack: DeepSeek-R1 8B LLM, Ollama, Sentence-Transformers, Python, FastAPI, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, UMAP, PostgreSQL, NCBI Entrez API. GitHub: https://github.com/sriramachellu/GenAI-Assisted-Interpretation-of-Metagenomic-Sequencing-Data. Demo: none.

section: Project: Pneumonia Detection Using Chest X-Rays
text: Project "Pneumonia Detection Using Chest X-Rays" (Machine Learning): Developed a deep learning based medical imaging classifier using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect pneumonia from over 5,800 pediatric chest X-ray images. Implemented data augmentation, dropout regularization, and fine-tuning strategies to improve generalization. Achieved 79.17% test accuracy with precision-recall evaluation and 97%+ training accuracy. Stack: PyTorch, CNN, Deep Learning, Python, Torchvision, Medical Imaging. GitHub: https://github.com/sriramachellu/Pneumonia-Detection-Using-Chest-X-Rays. Demo: none.

text: Software Developer at Popular Tech (June 2026 – Present, Irvine, CA). Full Stack Developer at Saayam For All (July 2025 – June 2026, San Jose, CA).
